# Factions & Organizations

## Aid Society {#aid-society}

The Aid Society is a community organization whose members meet at local homes, such as [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), for gatherings that include tea.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P40](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0040), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P41](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0041), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P42](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0042), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P43](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0043), +8 more_

**Members:** [Allan](../character/allan.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) brings the twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) Keith, home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) quickly displays his mischievous and unruly nature. Over the next few days, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) causes trouble by dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck at church, making [Dora](../character/dora.md) fall into a pigpen, and hiding a toad in Marilla's bed.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060)_

## Allans {#allans}

The Allans are guests and loved acquaintances who, along with Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), helped make conversation during a dinner at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P17](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0017), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P18](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0018), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P19](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0019), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P20](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0020), +14 more_

## American {#american}

Americans are summer visitors to the shore who stay at places like the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P22](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P23](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P24](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0024), +5 more_

## Bluenose {#bluenose}

A Bluenose is a native or member of an old family from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P30](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0030), [v3 ch.Lady P31](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0031), [v3 ch.Lady P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 ch.Lady P33](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0033), +14 more_

## Blythes {#blythes}

The Blythes are a family, including John and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), characterized by [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) as being exceptionally independent.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P36](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0036), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P38](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P39](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0039), +14 more_

## Boulters {#boulters}

The Boulters are a family characterized by a strongly developed contrary streak and a reputation for being mean, though they are also recognized as great business people.

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P53](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0053), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P54](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0054), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P55](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0055), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P56](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0056), +23 more_

## Canadian Woman {#canadian-woman}

The Canadian Woman is a publication or magazine that features short stories, including a story published by Margaret Burton.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P42](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0042), [v3 ch.Life P43](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0043), [v3 ch.Life P44](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0044), [v3 ch.Life P45](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0045), +17 more_

## Conservative {#conservative}

The Conservative party, whose members are also referred to as Tories, is a political faction whose supporters include the [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) household and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P5](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P7](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P8](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0008), +18 more_

**Members:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)

## Cottons {#cottons}

The Cottons are a family of half-wild, noisy, and reckless children, including Pete, [Tommy](../character/tommy.md), Adolphus, and [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md), who enjoy freedom and doing as they please.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Transgressors P29](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0029), [v3 ch.Transgressors P30](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0030), [v3 ch.Transgressors P31](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0031), [v3 ch.Transgressors P32](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0032), +16 more_

**Members:** [Tommy](../character/tommy.md)

## Cuthberts {#cuthberts}

The Cuthberts are a family, including siblings [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), who live together at their secluded [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) homestead known as [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), +5 more_

## Debating Club {#debating-club}

[The Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Debating Club is a respectable organization that meets fortnightly throughout the winter and hosts entertainments, such as concerts at the hall, to raise funds for the library.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P5](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P6](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P8](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0008), +16 more_

## Grit {#grit}

The Grits are a political party, opposing the [Conservatives](../codex/factions.md#conservative), whose members include some of the schoolboys as well as [Prissy](../character/priscilla-grant.md) Andrews's father and possibly Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P7](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P8](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P9](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0009), +14 more_

## Improvers {#improvers}

Also known as the A.V.I.S., the Improvers are a flourishing village improvement society whose members meet to discuss and carry out projects aimed at beautifying their local community.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P29](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0029), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P32](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0032), +30 more_

**Members:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Major Spencer](../character/major-spencer.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md)

## Indian {#indian}

_Not yet known._

## Liberal {#liberal}

The Liberals are a political faction whose adherents include [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), old [Martin](../character/martin.md) Bovyer, and Diana's father.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P37](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0037), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P38](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## Methodist {#methodist}

_Not yet known._

## Presbyterian {#presbyterian}

The Presbyterian church is a religious institution attended by the [Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) family as a matter of conscience.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P2](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXV. ## Pyes {#pyes}

The Pyes are a local family consisting of four households, characterized by some as attempt-driven control seekers who pool their financial leverage to secure contracts for their own kin.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P13](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0013), [v2 IX A Question of Color P14](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0014), [v2 IX A Question of Color P15](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0015), [v2 IX A Question of Color P16](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0016), +28 more_

**Members:** [John Andrew](../character/john-andrew.md)

## Rollings Reliable {#rollings-reliable}

The Rollings Reliable Baking Powder Company is a [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal)-based business that offered a twenty-five-dollar prize for the best story incorporating the name of their baking powder.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Down P2](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0002), [v3 ch.Down P3](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0003), [v3 ch.Down P4](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0004), [v3 ch.Down P5](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0005), +26 more_

## Sloanes {#sloanes}

The Sloanes are a village family characterized as good, honest, and respectable, yet defined by an inescapable inherent nature typical of their line.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Autumn P21](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0021), [v3 ch.Autumn P22](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0022), [v3 ch.Autumn P23](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0023), [v3 ch.Autumn P24](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0024), +6 more_

**Members:** [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md)

## Story Club {#story-club}

The Story Club was a group formed during their schooldays by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), in which they wrote thrilling stories.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P39](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0039), [v3 ch.Life P40](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0040), [v3 ch.Life P41](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0041), [v3 ch.Life P42](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0042), +14 more_

**Members:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)

## Wrights {#wrights}

The Wrights are a local family whose members include [Elisha Wright](../character/elisha-wright.md) and the deceased Mrs. Isaac Wright, known by some to be remarkably fickle.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P14](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0014), [v3 ch.Life P15](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0015), [v3 ch.Life P16](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0016), [v3 ch.Life P17](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0017), +23 more_

## Yankee {#yankee}

"Yankee" is a term used to describe people, magazines, or accents originating from the United [States](../codex/places.md#states).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P43](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0043), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P44](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0044), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P46](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0046), +23 more_
